# mailindex test fixtures

Real on-disk index files produced by the canonical mail-index
writer go in this directory. Tests in the parent package load
them as ground truth and assert that this Go implementation
round-trips them byte-for-byte.

## Sourcing fixtures

A fixture is one `dovecot.index` (+ optional `dovecot.index.log`,
`dovecot.map.index`) file pulled from a real running
installation or generated by running the canonical writer in a
controlled fixture-generator setup.

Naming convention:

```
testdata/
  fresh-empty/                     ← right after first sync
    dovecot.index
  one-folder-10-messages/          ← per-folder index with a small recordset
    dovecot.index
    dovecot.index.log
  mdbox-map-small/                 ← global map.index from a 3-message mdbox user
    dovecot.map.index
    dovecot.map.index.log
```

Each subdirectory has a `meta.json` describing what it contains
so tests can assert specific fields (UIDVALIDITY, next_uid,
extension names, record count, etc.) without re-parsing the
files.

## Status

**Empty for now.** Phase 1 ships with encoder/decoder + wire-spec
round-trip tests. Real fixture-parity tests land in a follow-up
once we have a deployment to pull files from. Until then the
encoder is validated against the byte-level spec via
`TestHeaderExactByteOffsets` and the per-record / per-tx
shape tests in `*_test.go`.
